evidence.quote: The rule is retained so that cases are evaluated against the policy effective on the delivery date. It does not govern deliveries made on or after 2026-01-15.
deliveries governed by the new policy use 14 calendar days from delivery. The previous 30-day rule remains applicable to cases whose governing delivery date falls before the effective date.

answer_parts.text: For a current return policy case involving deliveries made on or after January 15, 2026, the superseded 2025 rule (which allowed a 30-day window) does not apply. The applicable policy is the Standard Returns — 2026 version, which establishes a 14-calendar-day return window starting from delivery for direct-sale physical goods on the Standard plan.
